name: Carnivore's Corner
description: A house that celebrates the main event. Richer yields from the Lounge, but the heavier menu tests patience.
flavor: The regulars say the roasts here taste almost... familiar.

name: Sweet Parlor
description: Pastel frosting over everything. Guests linger happily and tip well, but the delicate kitchen cooks slower.
flavor: No one suspects a place with doilies.

name: Rustic Hearth
description: A crackling fire and hearty portions. The kitchen runs hot and fast, but hungry crowds arrive relentlessly.
flavor: Keep the pot full and nobody asks what is in it.
